title: Keep a fenced run wait pending across a transient native-locator read failure
outcome: A transient canonicalization failure is distinguished from a proved native-locator substitution: pending waits retain uncertainty and retry without accepting a different request/locator/input.
acceptance: A deterministic canonicalization-failure interleaving does not prematurely settle a matching running gate as UNKNOWN.
Actual changed native locator, request identity or pinned input still settles UNKNOWN and never supplies PASS.
The rightful project authority recovers on the next successful locator observation without a host restart.
